name: Zagadki starshej shkoly Sejshinaku
source: At Seishinaku High School, rumors have spread about ghosts at night. The main character Ai Tachibana and her friend Abe Kadum join a group of high school students who are explorers! But everyone came to this place for a reason...
translation: 在青神阁高中，关于夜间有鬼的谣言流传开来。主角橘爱和她的朋友阿部·卡杜姆加入了一群高中生探险家！但每个人来到这个地方都是有原因的……
